name: opencode-sro
description: Scope-aware, policy-enforced security research harness for OpenCode. Reads bug bounty engagements without credentials, blocks out-of-scope targets in code, separates hypotheses from verified findings, and never submits to a platform.

scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run build && python3 -c "import compileall,sys; sys.exit(0 if compileall.compile_dir('sro', quiet=1) else 1)"

opencode._comment: Metadata for the opencode.cafe listing. The plugin cannot ship agents, commands or instructions itself, so those are installed into ~/.config/opencode/ by the README instructions; this block documents the surface a user gets.

requires.notes: The plugin is a thin bridge. The authorization boundary is a Python package that ships with it, so there is no network path from the model to a scope or policy decision.
